# Topic Index

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The index note that links all artifacts for a topic.

## Scope note

Hub note connecting TopicPlan, TopicLog, TopicJournal, TopicReview, and related notes for a Topic.

## Broader

- [Topic Cluster](../TopicCluster/)
